title: Pyrolysis behavior of Sterculia guttata shell biomass: kinetics, thermodynamics, techno-economic and life cycle assessment of industrial-scale biochar production
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,10380-10399
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA09614F, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Subramaniyasharma Sivaraman, Rangabhashiyam Selvasembian
This study evaluates Sterculia guttata shell waste (SGSW) as a sustainable bioenergy feedstock using pyrolysis kinetics and thermodynamic analysis. Techno-economic and life cycle analyses support viability and sustainability at scale.
